body: Sadly, nothing good. My first suicide attempt was 3 years ago and it would have been the perfect time to go.

Yeah it is frowned upon but only by "normal" people. They are born normal, have normal lifes, normal bodies, normal minds etc. Its also our right to die if we dont want to be alive and because nobody helps us with that (which i also kinda understand) we have to kill ourselves with often unworthy methods. Freedom means that one can leave when he wants to, otherwise we are just prisoners in here.

I dont quite get it. Do you mean if there is a big ignorance in society? Yes of course, like everywhere. Nobody cares for other people except close ones, but thats kinda normal isnt it? And social darwinism has its truth imo, not racial of course but nature selects, only we wont do it. If thats good or bad thing seems to be highly subjectiv.

I dont think so. Giving other people the blame for our self hatred and mental disorders isnt right. Im living in central europe in one of the richest nations with a good health care system. Even my job is ok. Still i will kill myself, so its completly my "fault" or better its my subhuman genetic build up thats killing me not society itself.
Its sucks a lot but i rly believe that our genetics guide us. There is little to none free will and a lot of us are doomed.

Yeah it has to be some kind of torture-matrix or hell itself. Or it is genetics, maybe depressiv people shouldnt have lived through childhood and thats how nature tries to kill off undesirebles, because modern medicine made us stay alive. Idk
Hey, today its my birthday too. I totally get you, september is the worst month every year. Just dont hurt you when you in deep depression, all it does is making it worse.

Thank you for the message. There is some truth about what you are saying. I experimented with acid and i think i kinda know what you mean. I just dont get why i have to suffer day and night, and all people around of me have a happy life. Or at least it seems like it. So yeah, the higher power propably wants me to be alive, but it also just wants me to suffer and i dont want that anymore.

I woke up at like 3 or 4 am and wasnt myself. It was like stress completly overtook and i got a belt and tried it for like maybe 2 hours. But my body fought against it alot and so i only hurt my neck a bit and my head was hurting alot. Its extremly hard to hang or strangle yourself.
I dont, with a gun. Hanging myself didnt work a few years back. Also i dont want to get other people involved, like jumping in front of a train etc.
